PASS/FAIL/UNSTABLE policy is below:
	PASS	No setup/config/env errors + all tests passed	✅ Pass: Everything succeeded -->  report proceed
	UNSTABLE	No setup/config/env errors + ≥1 test failed	⚠️ Unstable: Environment okay but test(s) failed -->  report proceed
	FAIL	Any setup/config/env job failed	❌ Fail	Pre-test failure (such as ModuleNotFoundError, import failure, ect) --> No  report
